decisive_items: Ziehl-Neelsen staining: Positive for acid-fast bacilli
Large areas of necrosis rimmed by epithelioid cell granulomas with occasional Langhans' multinucleated giant cells
Bilateral upper-zone and mid-zone parenchymal infiltrates with nodular lesions
response.rationale: The positive acid-fast bacilli staining is pathognomonic for tuberculosis, supported by caseating granulomas and upper-zone infiltrates. Sarcoidosis is excluded by AFB positivity and suppurative necrosis. Lymphogranuloma venereum lacks supporting sexual history and has negative relevant tests.

rejected.why: AFB-positive staining directly contradicts sarcoidosis; necrosis with suppuration is atypical.
No high-risk sexual behavior, negative gonococci and syphilis tests, and no inguinal adenopathy; findings better explained by TB.
